node.statement: With K_sq enlarged once to dominate both the level-one constant and C_ca, all earlier inequalities remain valid because replacing K_sq by a larger constant only weakens their square lower bounds; shrink e_diag to include e_ca and the smallness bound used in node 1.4.1. Hence node 1.2 applies at n=2^(k+1) in every induction step. Combining p(a_{2^(k+1)})>=0 with a_{2^(k+1)}>=a_{2^k}/2>=r_+/2>r_- excludes the lower root interval and yields a_{2^(k+1)}>=r_+. The base and all-n transfer are then exactly as stated in the amended parent.
